description: Ministry of City Planning & water Supply - Order to acquire the Lands in Katuwangoda, Malimbada D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a public purpose (expansion of an access road to a pump house and water purification plant). It specifically describes the acquisition of an immovable property, provides a detailed schedule of the land including its location, boundaries, and extent, and lists the names and addresses of claimants. While it mentions a government minister and ministry, the core subject matter is land acquisition, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
